description: Floating Oasis AI assistant widget, smart search with auto-complete enhancements, dashboard customization system, and gamification UI components. This feature adds the major user-facing features: (1) A floating AI chat widget available on all pages, (2) Enhanced search with AI-powered suggestions and improved UX, (3) A dashboard widget customization system using Zustand, (4) Gamification UI elements (points display, badge animations, mini leaderboard widget).
steps: Create `frontend/src/components/OasisWidget.tsx` - A floating AI assistant widget that: (a) Renders as a fixed-position button (bottom-left for RTL, bottom-right for LTR - read dir from i18n store) with a Bot icon from lucide-react and a pulsing glow animation. (b) On click, expands into a chat panel (350px wide, 500px tall) with the same chat interface pattern from AiAssistantPage.tsx but simplified (message list + input). (c) Uses the existing `useAiChat` hook from hooks/useResources.ts for actual AI communication. (d) Has a minimize/close button. (e) Persists open/closed state in the UI store. (f) Shows 3 quick-suggestion chips when empty. (g) Supports the reveal animation from world-class.css. (h) All text uses the i18n `t()` function for bilingual support. CSS goes in world-class.css under `.oasis-widget` namespace.
Update `frontend/src/stores/ui.store.ts` - Add `oasisOpen: boolean`, `toggleOasis()`, `openOasis()`, `closeOasis()` actions to the existing UI store.
Update `frontend/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx` - Import and render `<OasisWidget />` inside the AppShell so it appears on all authenticated pages (after BottomNav).

Create `frontend/src/stores/dashboard.store.ts` - A Zustand store with persist middleware for dashboard customization: (a) `widgets: Array<{id: string, type: string, visible: boolean, order: number}>` with defaults for student dashboard widgets (stats, gpa, progress, term, agenda). (b) `toggleWidget(id)`, `reorderWidgets(ids)`, `resetDefaults()` actions. (c) Persist to localStorage with key 'madarek-dashboard-widgets'.

Create `frontend/src/components/DashboardCustomizer.tsx` - A modal/drawer component that: (a) Lists all available widgets with toggle switches. (b) Allows drag-like reordering (using up/down arrow buttons since we cannot add dnd libraries). (c) Has a 'Reset to defaults' button. (d) Opens via a Settings/Sliders icon button on the dashboard page header. (e) Uses i18n for all labels.

Update `frontend/src/pages/student/DashboardPage.tsx` - (a) Import dashboard store and conditionally render sections based on widget visibility. (b) Add the DashboardCustomizer trigger button in the page header. (c) Wrap each dashboard section in a container with `.reveal` class for scroll animations. (d) Add stagger delay using inline style `--stagger-index` CSS variable for entrance animations.

Create `frontend/src/components/GamificationWidget.tsx` - A compact widget showing: (a) Current XP with animated counter effect (CSS-based). (b) Current level with a radial progress ring (CSS conic-gradient). (c) Latest badge earned with a pulse/glow animation. (d) Mini 3-person leaderboard snippet. Uses data from useMyAchievements/useLeaderboard hooks. All text bilingual via i18n.

Enhance `frontend/src/components/layout/GlobalSearch.tsx` - Add: (a) AI-powered suggestion chips below the input when focused but empty (common academic queries). (b) Recent searches section (stored in localStorage via a small Zustand store or just component state). (c) Category filter pills (courses, lectures, papers, tracks) that pre-filter results. (d) Subtle slide-in animation for the dropdown using world-class.css classes. (e) Improved shimmer loading states instead of the basic shimmer spans.
acceptance_criteria: OasisWidget renders as a floating button on all authenticated pages
Clicking the Oasis button opens a chat panel with message input
Chat panel uses useAiChat hook for AI communication
Oasis widget respects RTL/LTR positioning based on i18n locale
Dashboard store persists widget visibility preferences to localStorage
DashboardCustomizer modal allows toggling widget visibility
Dashboard sections conditionally render based on store state
GamificationWidget shows XP, level, and mini leaderboard
GlobalSearch has suggestion chips when focused and empty
All new components use i18n t() for text strings
TypeScript compilation passes with no errors
verification: Run `npx tsc -b --noEmit` in frontend/ directory to confirm type-check passes
Run `npx vite build` in frontend/ directory to confirm build succeeds
findings: Same sandbox environment limitation as FEAT-001: TypeScript tsc and Vite build tools are not functional (node preload module error, npm registry blocked). Code follows identical patterns to existing stores/hooks/components. All imports verified against existing codebase exports. No new packages added. Removed unused Doughnut/Chart.js import from DashboardPage since the original code also did not use it in the JSX.
